title: Democrats Sweep Midterms as Trump Accepts Result; Dow Surges 3%
en: US stocks rallied sharply on Wednesday after the Democratic Party swept both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections, an outcome that eased fears of a prolonged political crisis. The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 3.03 percent to 53,356.12, its biggest one-day gain in eighteen months, while the S&P 500 rose 1.58 percent and the Nasdaq added 1.44 percent. President Trump said he would accept the result and was willing to work with Democrats, further calming investors. Big tech climbed, with Microsoft up more than 6 percent and Amazon up 6.1 percent, though AI-related chip and data-center stocks fell on expectations of tighter regulation.
zh: 美国中期选举后股市大涨：民主党横扫国会参众两院，缓解了市场对政治危机的担忧。道琼斯指数大涨3.03%报53356.12点，创18个月来最大单日涨幅；标普500涨1.58%，纳指涨1.44%。特朗普表态接受选举结果并愿与民主党合作，进一步安抚了投资者。大型科技股走高，微软涨超6%、亚马逊涨6.1%，但市场预期监管趋严，AI芯片与数据中心相关股票下跌。

title: Oil Plunges as Markets Bet on Faster End to US-Iran Conflict
en: Crude prices collapsed on Wednesday as traders bet that the Democrats' midterm victory will push Washington toward a diplomatic end to its conflict with Iran. US WTI crude for December delivery fell 8.3 percent to settle at 88.12 dollars a barrel, while Brent crude dropped 8.7 percent to 94.62 dollars, both hitting two-month lows. Vice President JD Vance publicly blamed the war for the Republican defeat, reinforcing expectations of de-escalation. Options markets turned decisively bearish, with volumes of December WTI puts about 1.6 times those of calls. Analysts noted the global oil market had already flipped into surplus in September and October as Middle East production recovered.
zh: 原油价格周三暴跌，交易员押注民主党中期选举获胜将促使华盛顿通过外交途径结束与伊朗的冲突。纽约12月WTI原油期货收跌8.3%报每桶88.12美元，布伦特原油跌8.7%报94.62美元，双双创两个月新低。副总统万斯公开将共和党败选归咎于这场战争，强化了局势降温预期。期权市场明显转空，12月WTI看跌期权成交量约为看涨期权的1.6倍。分析人士指出，随着中东产量恢复，9、10月全球油市已转为供应过剩。
vocab: adj. 看跌的；（行情）疲软的

title: Eurozone Inflation Climbs to 4.0% on Soaring Energy Costs
en: Eurozone inflation rose to 4.0 percent in October from 3.8 percent in September, Eurostat's flash estimate showed, hitting a three-year high as energy prices surged 20.8 percent year on year. Services inflation picked up to 3.3 percent, while core inflation, which excludes energy, food, alcohol and tobacco, held steady at 2.5 percent. Among major economies, Italy's rate jumped to 5.6 percent and France's rose to 3.8 percent, while Germany eased to 2.8 percent. Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said the European Central Bank will very likely need to raise interest rates in December.
zh: 欧盟统计局初步数据显示，受能源价格同比大涨20.8%推动，欧元区10月通胀率从9月的3.8%升至4.0%，创三年新高。服务通胀升至3.3%，剔除能源、食品、烟酒的核心通胀率维持在2.5%。主要经济体中，意大利升至5.6%，法国升至3.8%，德国回落至2.8%。德国央行行长约阿希姆·纳格尔表示，欧洲央行12月很可能需要加息。

title: Qualcomm Beats Estimates, Bets Big on Datacenter with Amazon Deal
en: Qualcomm reported better-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter results, with non-GAAP revenue of 10.44 billion dollars and adjusted earnings of 2.17 dollars per share, though its profit guidance disappointed and shares fell more than 7 percent after hours. Handset chip revenue tumbled 26 percent from the previous quarter as semiconductor costs rose across the board. The brighter story was diversification: automotive chip revenue surged 89 percent to a record 1.99 billion dollars, and the datacenter business turned commercial through a multi-generation custom-chip agreement with Amazon covering AI inference workloads. Qualcomm expects datacenter revenue to reach an annualized 7 billion dollars by the end of fiscal 2027.
zh: 高通第四财季业绩超预期：非GAAP营收104.4亿美元、调整后每股收益2.17美元，但盈利指引不及预期，盘后股价一度跌超7%。受半导体成本全面上涨拖累，手机芯片收入环比骤降26%。多元化业务成为亮点：汽车芯片收入同比大增89%至创纪录的19.9亿美元；数据中心业务通过与亚马逊签署多代定制芯片协议正式商业化，聚焦AI推理负载。高通预计到2027财年末数据中心收入将达年化70亿美元。

title: Apple Trims Internal AI Budgets as Usage Costs Soar
en: Apple is cutting the daily budgets that some engineers can spend on AI tools as it tries to rein in fast-rising costs, Bloomberg reported. Last month the company lowered the cap for some engineers from 300 dollars to 200 dollars a day, a 33 percent cut, and plans to push some teams down to 100 dollars. Non-engineering teams, currently at 100 dollars, could fall to as little as 25 dollars, though staff with greater needs can apply for exemptions. The budgets cover tokens consumed by models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google. The shift mirrors an industry-wide move from experimentation to cost accounting, as Microsoft and Tesla also tighten internal AI spending.
zh: 据彭博社报道，为遏制快速上升的成本，苹果正在削减部分工程师每天可使用的AI工具预算。上个月，苹果将部分工程师的日限额从300美元下调至200美元，降幅33%，并计划将部分团队进一步降至100美元；目前为100美元的非工程团队可能低至25美元，确有更高需求的员工可申请豁免。预算覆盖Anthropic、OpenAI和谷歌模型的词元消耗。这一转变折射出全行业从大规模试验转向成本核算，微软和特斯拉同样在收紧内部AI支出。

title: OpenAI's Security Model Finds 948 Privilege-Escalation Bugs in Linux Kernel
en: OpenAI said that an automated system built around a new cybersecurity model had uncovered 948 exploitable privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel. The system first screened about 2.8 million lines of code, roughly 7 percent of the kernel, and generated 2,308 candidate vulnerabilities within 12 hours at an API cost of 316,500 dollars. After 30 hours of dynamic testing in isolated virtual machines, 1,724 of the candidates, about 74.7 percent, were successfully reproduced, and the pipeline finally produced 948 distinct local privilege-escalation exploits that could let low-privileged users gain root access. OpenAI published root-cause analyses, proof-of-concept programs and candidate patches for security researchers to review.
zh: OpenAI表示，其围绕新一代网络安全模型搭建的自动化系统在Linux内核中发现了948个可利用的权限提升漏洞。该系统先筛选了约280万行代码（约占内核总量7%），12小时内生成2308个候选漏洞，API调用成本达31.65万美元。经过30小时在隔离虚拟机中的动态测试，1724个候选漏洞（约74.7%）成功复现，最终产出948个不同的本地提权漏洞利用，可使低权限用户获得root权限。OpenAI已公布根因分析、概念验证程序和候选补丁供安全研究人员审核。
